about: Per game. disagreements: PokéAPI vs Serebii species disagreements per area and version, each settled by the game's table on Bulbapedia's location page (source): keep/drop = a PokéAPI row Bulbapedia lists / doesn't list; add/skip = a Serebii-only row Bulbapedia lists / doesn't list; unresolved = no Bulbapedia table, PokéAPI's data stands. bulbapedia: every other wild row Bulbapedia's table doesn't list for that version: drop = Bulbapedia lists the Pokémon there for no version of the game (e.g. an unreleased event table), keep = not on its table (both other sources list it). rates: per Pokémon and method family, PokéAPI's chances (per time slot, summed over the place's parts) that differ from Bulbapedia's table: replace = Serebii's rows (which match Bulbapedia) are used instead; add = PokéAPI lacks the method there and Serebii's matching rows are added; add-bulbapedia = only Bulbapedia has it, its rows are added; keep = no two sources agree, PokéAPI's stand. Written by scripts/nuzlocke/build.ts.
